note: What a server sends to say something happened that the whole match is told about. What sort of thing is named first, and the sort settles what follows. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: event
fields.note: What sort of thing happened, and so which shape follows. Each name says what the sort is sent alongside, and each note what a client shows for it; the text of a notice that carries a map is the one that map gives it.

31.name: inhibitorDied
31.note: Sent as an inhibitor falls, with that inhibitor as source and the unit credited with it as subject. A client calls out the kill, naming the killer, the inhibitor and the assisters, where it holds the inhibitor as a building and knows the killer. Where it names the client's own champion and everything after it is zero, a client on map 1 shows a notice with no text of its own.

71.name: playerLeft
71.note: Sent as a player's client leaves the match, naming that player's champion as subject. A client announces that a player has quit; where the seat's name is unknown, a client names an unknown player.

118.name: minionsSpawned
118.note: Sent once, as the first minions come out. A client announces that minions have spawned.

119.name: welcome
119.note: Sent once, early in a match. A client announces the welcome for the map carried.

120.name: startNoticeTwo
120.note: Sent once, after welcome. A client announces the second notice for the map carried; on map 1 that minions spawn in thirty seconds.

121.name: startNoticeThree
121.note: A client on map 1 shows a notice with no text of its own.

127.name: nexusIdle
127.note: A client shows no notice for it.

151.name: dragonKilled
151.note: Sent as the dragon falls, with the champion credited as source. The kill details below follow.

152.name: dragonKilledWatched
152.note: The same, as sent to clients watching the match. The kill details below follow.

154.name: baronKilled
154.note: Sent as Baron Nashor falls, with the champion credited as source. The kill details below follow.

155.name: baronKilledWatched
155.note: The same, as sent to clients watching the match. The kill details below follow.

fields.name: source
fields.note: The unit the thing is credited to, or zero where none is.

fields.name: subject
fields.note: The unit the thing happened to, or zero where none is named.

fields.name: map
fields.note: Which map it happened on. It travels only with the three sorts that carry it.

fields.name: inhibitorGold
fields.note: Gold awarded for the inhibitor. It has no effect on a client.

fields.name: inhibitorAssistCount
fields.note: How many of the places below name an assister. A client names them where it is 0 to 11, and no assister from 12 up.

fields.name: inhibitorAssists
fields.note: Twelve places; those past inhibitorAssistCount have no effect.

fields.name: kill
fields.note: What comes with a dragon or Baron Nashor falling.

fields.name: gold
fields.note: The gold the kill gives.

fields.name: assistCount
fields.note: How many of the places below name a unit that helped.

fields.name: assists
fields.note: Units that helped, twelve places; the rest hold zero.

fields.name: skinHash
fields.note: The number a look's name gives.

fields.name: skin
fields.note: Which look.

fields.name: side
fields.note: Which side.
